stage_requirement: Each S0/S1/S2 frozen current Git snapshot gets separate actual Drive and Dropbox upload acknowledgements.
final_requirement: Each provider FINAL ZIP has its own sequential whole raw GET, CRC exhaustion, payload SHA256, native Git blob SHA1, actual extraction and extracted-file rehash receipt. Final external JSON then has two actual raw-byte readbacks.
payload: current private intake including raw failures and deltas
excluded: live temporary or signed URL transport files
parent_scope: Pinned whole parent ZIP/JSON bytes and existing restore evidence reused; no nested parent restore or science replay.
failure_preservation: Create-only outputs; preserve first failed GET and every attempt separately. No automatic retries or overwrite.
final_json_policy: Immutable external JSON contains actual preexisting receipts and controller status; excludes its own future hash, upload ACKs and readback receipt. Root binds those exact bytes after creation, avoiding circular self-reference.
scientific_admission: Owned by controller; packaging and upload acknowledgement do not issue scientific PASS.
